summary: Workflow and source code are production-quality: pinned action versions, minimal permissions (contents:read only), robust error handling with context, explicit TypeScript throughout, pragmatic XML parsing without external deps, modular design. CLI correctly exports functions for testing, handles both matrix fixture injection (results/ dir) and fallback to committed fixtures. No `any` types; type guards used correctly. However, task requires creating sample fixture files (fixtures/matrix/*.xml and *.json) and running all tests through act with act-result.txt output—these artifacts are missing from deliverable. Code itself is shippable; fixtures and test harness are gaps.
